name: c3
description: Marketplace for the c3 plugin: the Rust `c3` binary as a read-only reviewer bridge for Claude Code (Codex, Gemini through agy, Meta Muse through muse, and an OpenAI-compatible API through a native http engine), recording every consultation as files; needs the `c3` binary on PATH.

plugins.name: c3
plugins.description: Runs the `c3` binary as a read-only reviewer bridge from Claude Code and records each consultation as files (brief, verbatim reply, JSON ledger, findings tracked by id): a reviewer roster, a routed review panel, detached runs, member control, ratings and a scoreboard, sanitised packs, a local code index.
